agent.start.title: Check with an agent
agent.start.lead: The Touchdown command runs Claude Code or Codex on your computer. It looks for values that are well-formed but wrong, such as a type that does not fit the model or a livery spelled two ways, and suggests corrections. Nothing changes until you use one.
agent.start.setup: The command runs in the Touchdown directory: a copy of Touchdown's code on your computer. To set it up once, with Node.js 22 or later, run {clone}, then {cd} and {install}. Sign in to Claude Code or Codex, and choose it with {agent}. On Windows, type {npmRun} instead of {launcher}. <link>Setting up, in the README</link>.
agent.start.runStep: In a terminal, in the Touchdown directory, run:
agent.start.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the command instead.
agent.start.loadStep: Load the result it writes next to the request ({file}).
agent.start.sent: Sent to the agent: dates, airports, flight numbers, registrations, types, models, operators, liveries and phases. Notes are sent only after {notesOn}. Never ticket numbers, booking references, seats or photo links. The agent and its rules are set with {agent}.
